name: Pray to Snow
source:
Main character is a high school student who spends days lively with his childhood friend Yaya,  junior Umi Shibata, and friend Kazuto. One day another childhood friend Luna, who moved five years ago, gives a calls and says that she returns back. All the friends gather at the station and wait for Luna to arrive.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名高中生，他与青梅竹马的矢矢、初中的柴田海以及朋友和人一起度过了愉快的日子。有一天，五年前搬家的另一位儿时好友卢娜打电话说她回来了。所有的朋友都聚集在车站等待露娜的到来。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
